module_2.immediate_experiment: C repaired fixed-mixed AdamW followed by D task-statistics-only; distance0 already increased correction adoption without improving LasHeR.
module_2.later_experiment: Compare bounded Gram correction with a slack inequality-constrained correction in the eligible actual-displacement subspace; use real forward acceptance, no global no-regression or Pareto guarantee.
module_2.feasible_candidate_selection: Among risk-feasible candidates, measure retained objective improvement; correction frequency and zero-update frequency are not success measures.
module_2.routing: Allow useful Top-k changes; diagnose content-only, router-only and combined updates on fixed training clips before attributing harm to routing.

module_2.independent_confirmation: Use distinct training clips to generate and confirm the same correction, fixing transforms, candidate model/optimizer states and routing randomness across candidate comparisons. module_3.name: Independently intervening search-state propagation control

module_3.learning_accounting: Record preserved learning, backtracking, update rejection and additional forward cost; a zero-update candidate alone is not a solution.
module_3.crop_attribution: Fixed training clips: before-parameters/before-crop, after-parameters/before-crop, before-parameters/after-crop, after-parameters/after-crop. module_3.primary_route: Training-only neighboring search-state checks near measured crop-boundary sensitivity; use matched RGB/auxiliary geometry and preserve the inference crop pipeline.
module_3.separate_control: Continuous sampling versus integer crop quantization is an attribution control, not optimizer credit.
module_3.clip_expansion: Keep random coverage; add measured training-pool distractor/edge cases, then occlusion/reappearance only with correct visibility handling.

evidence_boundaries: Test sequence changes do not prove task-mean cancellation in training; record per-sample training damage first.
The observed near-zero denominator floor activation count is0; do not add defensive branches for an unobserved floor failure.
Route-set changes are associated with risk, not established causes, and stable route sets do not guarantee safety.
Saved fixed-pair whole-sequence bootstrap is conditional sampling uncertainty, not training-seed variance or module attribution.
Distance0 has12 trajectory-only events without alternatives; removing distance penalty did not close this gap.
Same-batch improvement does not establish transfer to independent clips; raw/deployment decode differences do not establish benchmark causation.
Printed total and router classification use different task/sample weighting; their subtraction is only an arithmetic residual.
